installer-gui-script.title: Tread SDK @VERSION@
installer-gui-script.welcome:
This installs the Tread SDK @VERSION@ (compiler, bytecode tools and runtime) in /Library/Tread and adds /Library/Tread/bin to PATH for new terminal windows.
Go is not required.
installer-gui-script.conclusion:
Tread is installed. Open a new terminal window and run:
tread --version tread doctor
To uninstall: sudo /Library/Tread/uninstall.sh
